name: LEGACY_PSI_SERIAL_BASELINE_20261021

dataset.candidate_generation: 4 ROP values x 8 target increments; no candidate pruning

measurement.preparation: input read, input SHA256, parsing and reusable request construction once per fresh process
measurement.compute: fresh state, SetBucket preparation, original bucket loop, result objects; not serialization
measurement.serialize: all PSI rows into identical little-endian binary layout, including order and due dates
measurement.store: exclusive new file, full write, file fsync and close; no directory fsync or database
measurement.total: compute + serialize + hash + store within one call; excludes preparation and container/build/startup
measurement.statistics: median, nearest-rank sample P95, min, max, population standard deviation; no samples dropped
measurement.equality: all payload SHA256 and exact bytes must agree across languages and repetitions

excluded: source database access, canonical sealing and input admission
segmentation and policy candidate generation runtime
service aggregation and final policy selection
actual JSON/Parquet Evidence Writer, outbox and publication
production parallel execution and deployed binary identity
algorithm optimization, JIT/Numba or production strategy changes
